name: vp-whos-winning
description: VP's WhosWinningPopup.lua (Core Files\Overrides) OnPopup: rolls the synced RNG (Game.Rand: the presenter out of 25, then list modes until a new allowed one) and reads the scores of the mode (GetMilitaryMight is a lazy cache; RefreshTourism changes cities). The popup stays up, which stops the human turn's unit cycle and end-of-turn test.

contains: Rolling to determine Progress Screen list type.
